levelsysHelp:
**Levelsystem Settings Help**

> `{0}levelsys enable`
> <:Reply:1087438925632643082> Enables the level system
> `{0}levelsys disable`
> <:Reply:1087438925632643082> Disables the level system

> `{0}levelsys xp <Number>`
> <:Reply:1087438925632643082> Sets the number of XP a user gets per message
> `{0}levelsys cooldown <Seconds>`
> <:Reply:1087438925632643082> Sets the cooldown time between messages to get XP

> `{0}levelsys modify <xp | level> <add | remove | set> <User> <Number>`
> <:Reply:1087438925632643082> Adds, removes or sets the amount of XP or level for a user

> `{0}levelsys current`
> <:Reply:1087438925632643082> Shows the current settings
messageDescription:
**Levelsystem Settings Help**

> `{0}levelsys message <Message>`
> <:Reply:1087438925632643082> Sets the message that will be sent when leveling up
> `{0}levelsys message show`
> <:Reply:1087438925632643082> Shows the current level up message
> `{0}levelsys mention <on | off>`
> <:Reply:1087438925632643082> Enables or disables the mention in a level up message
> `{0}levelsys channel <Channel>`
> <:Reply:1087438925632643082> Sets the channel in which the level up message will be sent

> `{0}levelsys custom add <Level> <Message>`
> <:Reply:1087438925632643082> Sets a custom message for a specific level
> `{0}levelsys custom remove <Level>`
> <:Reply:1087438925632643082> Removes a custom message for a specific level
> `{0}levelsys custom show <Level | all>`
> <:Reply:1087438925632643082> Shows a specific custom message or an overview of all messages

> Variables for the message:
> `{{user_mention}}`, `{{user_name}}`, `{{user_discriminator}}`
> `{{level}}`, `{{xp_needed}}`, `{{level_next}}`
> And for custom messages:
> `{{role}}`
rolesDescription:
**Levelsystem Settings Help**

> `{0}levelsys role add <Level> <Role>`
> <:Reply:1087438925632643082> Sets a level up role that is given when leveling up
> `{0}levelsys role remove <Level>`
> <:Reply:1087438925632643082> Removes a level up role
> `{0}levelsys role show <Level | all>`
> <:Reply:1087438925632643082> Shows a specific level up role for a level or an overview of all roles
blacklistDescription:
**Levelsystem Settings Help**

> `{0}levelsys blacklist <channel | role> <add> <channel | role>`
> <:Reply:1087438925632643082> Adds a channel or role to the blacklist
> `{0}levelsys blacklist <channel | role> remove <channel | role>`
> <:Reply:1087438925632643082> Removes a channel or role from the blacklist
> `{0}levelsys blacklist show`
> <:Reply:1087438925632643082> Shows the current channels and roles on the blacklist
resetDescription:
**Levelsystem Settings Help**

> `{0}levelsys reset user <user>`
> <:Reply:1087438925632643082> Resets a user's data
> `{0}levelsys reset all`
> <:Reply:1087438925632643082> Resets all user data
> `{0}levelsys reset settings`
> <:Reply:1087438925632643082> Resets all settings
